extra.final_summary: The data had three main issues affecting the question: (1) Category labels had extra spaces and case variants (e.g., ' Electronics', ' Furniture', 'Office Supplies ') which were normalized to the allowed labels; (2) The Price column contained text with dollar signs ('$300.00') which were converted to numbers; (3) One row (row 40) had a negative Quantity (-6), which violates the rule that Quantity must be at least 1, so it was excluded; and (4) One exact duplicate row (row 31) was removed. After these fixes, the analysis shows 9 orders in Accessories, 11 in Electronics, 14 in Furniture, and 12 in Office Supplies.
